info.title: Second Memory API
info.description: Second Memory admin API. Admin routes authenticate with the Sanctum session cookie: call `GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie`, then `POST /admin/credential/login`, and send the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header on writes (ADR-0004). Every response uses the `{ data, error: { status, code, messages } }` envelope.

duration.description: Video or audio length in seconds (MEDIA-11)

preview.description: How the file can be shown without downloading it; null: download only, not available, or locked

locked.description: true: in a folder the signed-in admin may not use (ADR-0017); the name shows, the file does not open

created_at.description: Full timestamp (ISO 8601): the time of day matters in an audit trail
